description.value:
When Arasaka Security details require adaptability, automatic fire, and a compact size to fit inside an AV, the Masamune is too large, the Shingen can’t quickly swap targets, and the Kenshin lacks range. Thus, the TKK-50 Hideyoshi, an older model that’s never sold well commercially, is their firearm of choice. It blends the best of Arasaka’s other designs into a lightweight and accurate PDW/Carbine hybrid with a surprisingly high muzzle velocity. This comes at the expense of any prebuilt smartlinks and electromags, so while the Hideyoshi is competent, its user must be as well for it to truly thrive.

Cost: 1,200eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Excellent Quality Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Carbine

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 50 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Foregrip • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 2 rounds in a burst. If there are not 2 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine and deals 1d6 less damage (2d6).

Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Foregrip (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
